_what: Omitted converter losses (dead time, core, AC winding, dielectric) for the integration-study regulator at each case's own tier temperatures, and for every feasible count of the regulator-count DSE (case D). Bundles: low / nominal / high (see 'assumptions').

dead_time.justification: TI LMG1210 (GaN half-bridge driver, SNOSD12D): minimum dead time 0.8 ns typ / 3.1 ns max, adjustable to 20 ns, HO/LO delay mismatch 1 ns typ / 3.4 ns max; at 2 ns the switch node of this cell (t_c ~ 1 ns at the peak current) just completes its transition, so < 2 ns is not realizable without shoot-through risk; 10 ns is half the driver's maximum setting and a conservative fixed dead time at sub-MHz switching
dead_time.V_SD: datasheet reverse characteristic (V_GS = 0, 25/125 C) digitized; 'table' variant shifts it to the tabulated V_SD(0.5 A) (EPC2057 1.4 V; the figure reads ~2.4 V at 1 A -- the datasheet is internally inconsistent)
dead_time.commutation: t_c = (Q_OSS,HS + Q_OSS,LS)(V_in/N) / I_peak; high bundle sets t_c = 0

core.material: TY-M5 (Taiyo Yuden metal composite) specific loss at 10 MHz digitized from the cited source: P_v = 1.08e+04 W/m3 x (B_pk/1 mT)^2.2125
core.frequency_scaling: P_v ~ f^alpha, alpha 1.0 (upper bound) to 1.5; iGSE triangular-flux factor at the buck duty
core.temperature: metal composite: no temperature coefficient (nominal); 'ferrite_like' sensitivity uses the Ferroxcube 3F4 500 kHz / 50 mT curve normalized at 25 C

cases.low: soft saturation: 10 % L drop reached at 0.6 B_sat; alpha 1.5
cases.nominal: B reaches B_sat = 1.25 T at the library I_sat = 23 A; core fills the 1 mm2 x 500 um envelope; alpha 1.25 (metal composite)
cases.high: all magnetic energy in a closed mu_r = 15 core confined to the envelope (contradicts I_sat = 23 A, so a bound); alpha = 1 (energy per cycle cannot rise as f falls below the 10 MHz data)

assumptions.ac_winding: R_ac/R_dc vs frequency of the cited segment (FEM, Fig. 9b, 3-98 MHz) applied to the library DCR; below 3 MHz: nominal R_dc + a f^b fit, high Dowell fit, low quadratic eddy regime; temperature via delta ~ sqrt(rho/f); includes the ripple the model books with the summed output ripple instead of the per-branch ripple
assumptions.dielectric: ESR_diel = DF/(2 pi f C_eff) over the odd harmonics of the flying-cap current; the library ESR is specified at ~10 MHz (HVR_FULL_OPT_EPC_V2.Capacitor.esr_mohm), where the dielectric share is negligible, so the whole dielectric term is counted as omitted; DF falls 0.4 %/K (floor 30 %)
assumptions.dse_temperature: the DSE scores components at 25 C; omitted terms evaluated at 25 C and at 100 C (a uniform operating temperature)

inductor.name: Shared_Core_UIC_250_nH
inductor.material: Taiyo Yuden TY-M5 metal composite (mu_r 15, B_sat 1.25 T), per the cited source (Rasheedi et al., inductor-array TCPMT manuscript, Table II, Fig. 6)
inductor.provenance_caveat: the cited segment is 50 nH / 8.2 mOhm in 0.2 mm2; 250 nH equals five segments in series while 1.6 mOhm equals five in parallel, so no flux density follows from the library entry itself -- the core loss is therefore bracketed by three flux models

dead_time_events.currents: valley (full t_dt, before HS turn-on) and peak (t_dt - t_c, after HS turn-off); HS devices never reverse-conduct

cases.low: soft saturation: 10 % L drop reached at 0.6 B_sat; alpha 1.5
cases.nominal: B reaches B_sat = 1.25 T at the library I_sat = 23 A; core fills the 1 mm2 x 500 um envelope; alpha 1.25 (metal composite)
cases.high: all magnetic energy in a closed mu_r = 15 core confined to the envelope (contradicts I_sat = 23 A, so a bound); alpha = 1 (energy per cycle cannot rise as f falls below the 10 MHz data)

notes: T_ls above the 125 C datasheet curve: V_SD extrapolated linearly in T; also above the 150 C EPC2057 rating

out_of_scope_flags.coss_term: the model's C_OSS term (C = Q_OSS/V_DSmax, LS at V_out) is ~5-7x below a datasheet hard-turn-on estimate (E_OSS,HS + Q_OSS,LS V_sw - E_OSS,LS); the deficit scales with f like dead time but is larger for N = 2 (24 V swing); see out_of_scope_coss_check
out_of_scope_flags.flying_cap_rating: C1 holds V_in(N-1)/N = 32 V in the N=3 cell (manuscript Fig. 2) but the selected Murata GCM21 part is rated 25 V; the synthesis filter only checks v_max > V_in/N
out_of_scope_flags.stacked_hs_rating: S2..SN block 2 V_in/N during the opposite phase (32 V for N=3; 48 V for N=2 > 40 V EPC2014C rating in the M=56-76 designs); the device filter only checks V_DSmax >= V_in/N
